summary.lv: SIA ELVI Latvija, nacionālais mazumtirdzniecības tīkls, meklē IT konsultantu/-tehniķi veikalu un biroju IT atbalstam, datortehnikas sagatavošanai un tīkla problēmu risināšanai.
summary.en: ELVI Latvia, a national retail chain, is seeking an IT consultant/technician to provide on-site and remote IT support for stores and offices, configure hardware (POS systems, network equipment), and maintain IT infrastructure.
